acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce with recorded Git metadata fingerprints and distinguish clean stable state from concurrent index refresh or legitimate metadata drift.
Retain actual refusal evidence and precise diagnosis; preserve fail-closed observation when metadata cannot be safely observed.
If advice is inaccurate, narrow it under existing workflow requirements with focused checks and independent review; do not waive required CEM or source-state binding.
body: Suspected tooling friction during V1-0556 terminal workflow, not a confirmed correctness bug. Installed Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163, Tasks202, Darwin arm64, Go1.27.1. At private leaf /private/tmp/corvint-394-freshness clean committed target432bbe0e5dad32335a599ee4d80048cde669d645, actual make dogfood-change BASE=f51f3c9e6fbfc5a6b219692e8bf46e4e43297a36 (62cited hunks,1honest bootstrapunknown,47unassessedOCM) returned exit2 local-outcome record-index-failed. Actual .git/corvint/local-outcome.stderr: Git status cannot safely observe repository metadata: repository metadata changed during observation. Before/after git status --short was empty and git diff --stat empty. Coordinator printed generic uncommitted-worktree advice. Expected either clean observation succeeds or retained diagnostic identifies actual transient metadata drift; actual refusal remains fail-closed. Concurrent read/index-refresh effects have not been excluded, so root cause and repeatability are UNKNOWN. Original fail report/log retained in /private/tmp/corvint-394-pre-ownership-clean-change.log and .corvint/dogfood-report.json at that historical target; later approved metadata repair changes target. Dedup searches repository metadata changed and record-index-failed found no matching root-cause item; V1-0175 and V1-0386 address different uncommitted/sidecar paths. No state/trace rewriting or guard bypass requested.
title: Investigate clean dogfood recorder metadata observation refusal
